uncited: The manager maintains two `Data3DTexture` slots (ping-pong buffers).
If `float32Filterable` is true, set format to `R32F` (`FloatType`, `Float32Array`, `LinearFilter`); otherwise, fallback to `R16F` (`HalfFloatType`, `Uint16Array`).
Compute `min` and `max` of the field data.
If `min == max`, widen `max` by 1 to prevent division by zero during normalization.
Replace non-finite values (NaN/Inf) with `min`; if all values are non-finite, use 0.
Otherwise, swap to the inactive ping-pong slot.
Copy `newField` data into the inactive slot.
Bump the inactive slot's `version` property to trigger GPU re-upload.
- Constant fields cause division by zero during normalization.
- Shape mismatches during `setField` break the ping-pong buffer.
